how: A commit cannot name its own hash. The FREEZE commit lands PREREG.md, the harness, the adjudicator, the tests and the real-emitter fixtures with this field reading PENDING; a SECOND, stamping commit replaces it with the freeze commit's 40-hex sha. `launch_local.sh` REFUSES to launch while it still says PENDING.
what_is_frozen: PREREG.md — design, the selector, the bar, the branch map, the gates, the non-inference limits
synth_mech.py — the generator, the ply selector, the FROZEN stratifier (build_targets) and the four-arm pricer, with every constant in one block
adjudicate_synth.py — the gates and the READ_RULE executor
test_synth.py + selftest_fixture/ — the contract tests and the REAL-EMITTER fixtures
launch_local.sh — the fail-closed launcher (band + blind-commit + negctrl + smoke gates)

what_is_NOT_frozen_and_why.targets_synth.jsonl: does not exist yet — the target set is produced BY the harvest, from the frozen selector, at launch time. What is frozen is the SELECTOR and its stopping rule (PREREG 2.2, 2.3, 5.4), not a ply list. The harvest is outcome-blind: no continuation is played until the target set is final, so the adaptive stop introduces no selection bias.
what_is_NOT_frozen_and_why.n_defense/n_control: targets are 200 each with a hard floor of 160 (G-N); the realized n depends on the measured yield and is recorded in SELECTION.json.

state_at_freeze.dry_smoke_disclosure: PREREG.md §0.2 item 3 — throwaway seeds 999900000000+, OUTSIDE every registered band, on games that can never enter a frozen target set. Units kept on disk; real-emitter copies in selftest_fixture/.
state_at_freeze.pre_freeze_probe: PREREG.md §0.2 item 2 — 32 throwaway games, 1,185 selector rows, 576 eligible plies. Priced NOTHING (no continuation played, so no delta existed for any ply in either family). Its measured covariates size the round.
